AddonSummary.description: AddonSummary contains basic addon info for listings

name.description: name identifies the item. For KindRegion it is the region name.

operation.description: operation is the IAM action that failed, such as "eks:DescribeNodegroup".

retryable.description: retryable reports whether running the same command again, with no other change, may succeed. It is always encoded.

error.description: error is one line of human text. Do not parse it; use Reason.

awsErrorCode.description: awsErrorCode is the raw AWS API error code, such as AccessDeniedException, when the failure came from an API response.

Failure.description: Failure is one item refresh could not read, or one action it attempted that did not complete. The JSON and YAML keys are a public contract (docs/concepts/output.md): later versions only add fields.

FailureKind.description: FailureKind is the type of item a Failure is about.

FailureList.description: A list of failures. It is [] when there are none, never null.

FailureReason.description: FailureReason is why a Failure happened, from a closed set. Scripts branch on it. Later versions may add reasons; consumers must accept unknown values.

Health.description: Health is an add-on's health, derived from its EKS status.

apiVersion.description: The version of the document contract.

failures.description: Every failure of the run: the items refresh could not read and the actions that did not complete. This top-level list is complete; a nested failure or failures field repeats a subset of it. The list is sorted by kind, region, cluster, name, and operation. [] when there are no failures.

title: AddonList
description: The document that `refresh addon list -o json` prints. -o yaml prints the same structure.
